project_name: Ascend Visual Creatives (AVC) - Awwwards Marketing Agency
archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) - Mixed with High-Contrast Swiss

typography.secondary_heading: Cormorant Garamond (Use exclusively for italicized luxury accent words)
typography.rules: No Inter for headings. Use extreme contrast in font weights (e.g., Cabinet Grotesk Black vs Cormorant Garamond Light Italic). Apply 'tracking-tighter' to massive headings. Body text should be readable with 'leading-relaxed'.

colors.rules: Absolutely no cheap colors. The aesthetic relies entirely on lighting, contrast, and depth in a monochromatic spectrum.

grids_and_layouts.hero: 100vh full bleed. Absolutely centered massive logo. 3D canvas positioned absolute behind the logo with z-index -1.
grids_and_layouts.work_reels: Horizontal pinned scroll section (Bento grid mode A adaptation). The user scrolls down, but the reels move horizontally.
grids_and_layouts.stats: CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) with massive typography and 1px border dividers (border-collapse style).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-32 or py-48 for section transitions. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.

visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom magnetic cursor. Use a fixed framer-motion div (mix-blend-difference) that scales up when hovering over interactive elements or reels.
visual_enhancers.noise: Subtle SVG noise/grain overlay across the entire site (fixed, pointer-events-none, opacity 3%).
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Crystal Glass variant for sticky header (backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-black/60, border-b border-white/10).

motion.scroll_engine: MANDATORY: Install and use `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for premium momentum scrolling.
motion.hero_choreography: On initial load: Logo scales up from 0.8 to 1 with a slow 1.5s ease-out. On scroll down: Use framer-motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` to aggressively scale the massive logo down and fade it out as the next section overlaps it.
motion.text_reveals: Split text by lines or words. Reveal using framer-motion clip-path (polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0% 100%)) and y-axis translation. Never just fade in.
motion.parallax: Apply subtle y-axis parallax to images, 3D canvases, and background text elements to create depth.

3d_libraries.implementation: In the Hero section, implement a rich, dark `MeshDistortMaterial` or `MeshTransmissionMaterial` on a massive Sphere or Plane. It should slowly rotate and distort (speed ~1.5, distort ~0.4) reacting to lighting to create a cinematic, liquid obsidian/chrome look behind the massive logo. Ensure lighting (AmbientLight + DirectionalLight) is stark white to catch specular highlights.

media.logo_treatment: Must be prominently visible. Set `w-[90vw] md:w-[70vw] max-w-5xl mx-auto`. No small dissolved logos.

reels.treatment: Wrap iframes in a div with `overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10`. Add a glassmorphism hover effect.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on deep black background. Gray text must be at least #8A8A93.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-logo"`, `data-testid="contact-submit-button"`).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap heavy 3D and scroll effects in a prefers-reduced-motion media query check.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL REQUIRED DEPENDENCIES: `yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`
Do not use TypeScript (.tsx). Write all components as .jsx files.
Build a monolithic but well-structured App.jsx or break down into cleanly named .jsx components.

HERO SECTION IS CRITICAL: Do not use a generic split layout. The background should be the dark React Three Fiber canvas. The foreground is the massive Logo image centered, spanning almost the width of the screen.
SCROLL ANIMATIONS: Standard fades are rejected. You MUST use Framer Motion's `useScroll` to map scroll progress to scaling, translation, and opacity. Create a horizontal scroll section for the Reels.

REELS SECTION: Create 4 massive cards. Since actual embed codes aren't provided, use dummy youtube/instagram iframes (e.g., `src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/SHORT_VIDEO_ID"` or styled placeholder divs that perfectly mimic 9:16 video players with a play button), but style the wrappers luxuriously with glassmorphism.

BRAND MARQUEE: Use Framer Motion to create an infinite slow-scrolling marquee of the brand names (META, TATA, VIVRE, PROVO, etc.). Format them in the Cabinet Grotesk font, uppercase, outlined text (`text-transparent text-stroke-white`).
CURSOR: Implement a fixed div that follows the mouse (x/y mapped via framer-motion mouse event listener). Make it `mix-blend-difference` so it inverts the colors behind it.
COLORS: The user hates the previous yellow/gold. Stick STRICTLY to the Dark Luxury Monochrome palette. No colors except Black, White, and dark shades of Gray.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toasts if any notifications are needed.
